item.title: Supreme council race also too close to call... Pro-Lee Park Sun-won overtakes pro-Chung Choi Min-hee for first place (與최고위원도 박빙...친명 박선원 1위로 친청 최민희 역전)
item.description:
Supreme council race also too close to call... Pro-Lee Park Sun-won overtakes pro-Chung Choi Min-hee for first place (與최고위원도 박빙...친명 박선원 1위로 친청 최민희 역전)

At the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention regional primaries held in Jeju and Incheon on the 8th, party leader candidate Kim Min-seok defeated candidate Chung Chung-rae, while the supreme council member election is also seeing a razor-thin race, with rankings between pro-Lee and pro-Chung candidates flipping. (8일 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 제주·인천 순회경선에서 김민석 당대표 후보가 정청래 후보를 제치고 승리한 가운데, 최고위원 선거도 친명·친청 후보 순위가 뒤바뀌는 등 박빙을 벌이고 있다.)

So Byung-hoon, chairman of the Democratic Party's central election management committee, announced on the 8th at the Incheon regional primary joint speech event held at Namdong Gymnasium to elect the party leader and supreme council members that candidate Park Sun-won received the most votes with 16,819. Park, who had been in second place in cumulative totals, overtook candidate Choi Min-hee (16,060 votes), who had been leading the primary until that day. They were followed by candidate Seo Mi-hwa (14,289 votes) and candidate Han Min-soo (13,610 votes). (소병훈 민주당 중앙당 선거관리위원장은 8일 인천 남동체육관에서 열린 당대표·최고위원 선출을 위한 인천 순회경선 합동연설회 후 결과 발표에서 박선원 후보가 가장 많은 1만 6819표를 받았다고 밝혔다. 박 후보는 여태 합산 2위였지만 이날 1위로 경선서 1위를 달렸던 최민희 후보(1만 6060표)에 역전했다. 이어 서미화 후보(1만 4289표), 한민수 후보(1만 3610표) 였다.)

The competition to enter the winning zone for supreme council membership is also intense. Candidate Kim Yong (12,493 votes), considered one of the closest associates of Leader Lee Jae-myung, secured a spot within the top five winning positions. He was followed by pro-Chung candidate Lee Sung-yoon (11,896 votes), candidate Im Mi-ae (6,265 votes), and candidate Kim Young-ho (2,964 votes). (최고위원 당선권에 들기 위한 경쟁도 팽팽하다. 이 대통령의 최측근으로 꼽히는 김용 후보(1만 2493표)가 당선권인 5위안에 들었다. 이어 친청계 이성윤 후보(1만 1896표), 임미애 후보(6265표), 김영호 후보(2964표)가 뒤를 이었다.)

At the supreme council candidate policy speech session that day, the clash between pro-Lee and pro-Chung factions was also fierce. (이날 최고위원 후보 정견 발표에서도 친명, 친청계 간 공방은 치열했다.)

Pro-Lee candidate Kim Yong said that day, "Our Democratic Party bids farewell to outdated practices. We move toward the future. We move toward the future with Lee Jae-myung," adding, "It must be a party that parts with old ways and moves forward with Lee Jae-myung, a party for everyone that is not divided by factions and earns the people's love and trust, a party walking the path of innovation." (친명계 김용 후보는 이날 “우리 민주당은 구태와 결별한다. 미래로 간다. 이재명과 함께 미래로 간다”며 “구태와 결별하고 이재명과 함께 미래로 가는 민주당, 계파로 나뉘지 않고 국민의 사랑과 신뢰를 받는 모두의 민주당, 혁신의 길로 가는 민주당이어야 한다”고 했다.)

He then cited the phrase "the waves behind on the Yangtze drive the waves ahead," saying, "The front waves of the Yangtze must not block the rear waves. We must open the path for the waves behind." (그러면서 ‘장강의 뒷물결이 앞물결을 밀어낸다’는 뜻의 ‘장강후랑추전랑’을 언급하며 “장강의 앞물이 뒷물을 막아서면 안 된다. 뒷물에 길을 열어야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding candidate Chung, he said, "He cannot embrace 160 National Assembly members, yet he is picking fights with 1.6 million paid party members." (그는 정 후보에 대해 “160명 국회의원을 품지 못하면서 160만명의 권리당원과 싸움을 붙이고 있다”고도 했다.)

Pro-Lee candidate Seo Mi-hwa said, "When the ruling party leader should naturally raise his voice, how can he protect the president by consistently saying 'no comment'?" Candidate Park Sun-won, targeting former leadership member Chung, said, "The Chung Chung-rae leadership has no further mission. There is nothing left for them to do." (친명계 서미화 후보는 “집권 여당 대표가 당연히 목소리를 내야 할 때 ‘노코멘트’로 일관하며 어떻게 대통령을 지킨단 말인가”라고 했다. 박선원 후보는 전임 지도부인 정 후보를 향해 “정청래 지도부는 더 이상 임무 없다. 더 이상 할 일 없다”라고 했다.)

In contrast, the pro-Chung faction argued that the convention rules favor candidate Kim Min-seok and pushed a narrative of defending candidate Chung. Candidates Choi Min-hee, Han Min-soo, and Lee Sung-yoon particularly criticized the calls from some pro-Lee quarters for supplementary voting for those who did not cast ballots in the primary, saying, "The game is already underway, and now they want to change the rules of the game." (반면 친청계는 전당대회 규칙이 김민석 후보 측에 유리하다고 주장하며 정 후보 수호론을 펼쳤다.최민희·한민수·이성윤 후보는 특히 친명계 일각에서 경선 미투표자에 대한 보완 투표를 주장하는 것을 두고 “경기가 이루어지고 있는데 경기 룰을 바꾸자고 한다”라고 비판했다.)

Candidate Lee Sung-yoon said, "They are trying to amend the convention rules, introduce a preferential voting system not stipulated in the party constitution, throw tantrums demanding unqualified candidates be registered, and demand additional voting even after the vote has ended—this is a voting coup d'état not found in party regulations." He added, "Please protect our leader Chung Chung-rae from the 'gang-up' politics of 1 against 5, 1 against 3, 1 against dozens." (이성윤 후보는 “전당대회 룰을 고치면서 당헌에 있지 않은 선호투표제를 도입하고 후보자 등록 때 무자격자를 등록해달라고 생떼 쓰고 투표가 끝났는데도 추가 투표를 요구하고 있다”며 “당규에도 없는 투표 쿠데타”라고 했다. 그러면서 “1대 5, 1대 3, 1대 수십 명의 ‘다구리’(몰매) 정치로부터 우리 정청래 대표를 지켜달라”고 했다.)

item.title: In Party Convention, Candidate Kim Min-seok Wins in Jeju and Incheon Primaries... Cumulative Results Show Kim Min-seok Overtaking (與 전대, 제주·인천 경선에서 김민석 후보 승리...누적 김민석 역전)
item.description:
In Party Convention, Candidate Kim Min-seok Wins in Jeju and Incheon Primaries... Cumulative Results Show Kim Min-seok Overtaking (與 전대, 제주·인천 경선에서 김민석 후보 승리...누적 김민석 역전)

Regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, the results of the party member voting in the Jeju and Incheon regions showed that candidate Kim Min-seok surpassed candidate Jung Cheong-rae in both Jeju and Incheon. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회와 관련, 제주·인천지역 권리당원 투표 결과, 김민석 후보가 제주, 인천 지역에서 모두 정청래 후보를 앞서는 결과를 보였다.)

Combining the results from the Chungcheong region, Busan·Ulsan·South Gyeongsang, and Jeju·Incheon regions, candidate Kim Min-seok placed first with 45.41%, followed by candidate Jung Cheong-rae with 44.57%, and candidate Song Young-gil with 10.03%. (앞서 충청과 부산·울산·경남, 제주·인천 지역 모두 합산한 결과 김민석 후보가 1위로 45.41%, 정청래 후보 44.57%, 송영길 후보 10.03% 순이다.)

For the supreme council member race, pro-Chung Cheong-gye candidate Choi Min-hee placed first with 21.04%, pro-Myung candidate Park Sun-won received 16.8%, pro-Chung Cheong-gye candidate Han Min-su received 14.45%, candidate Seo Mi-hwa received 14.11%, and pro-Myung candidate Kim Yong received 12.64%. (최고위원의 경우 친청계 최민희 후보가 1위로 21.04%, 친명계 박선원 후보 16.8% 친청계 한민수 후보 14.45%, 서미화 후보 14.11%, 친명계 김용 후보 12.64%를 얻었다.)

Outside the ranking range were candidate Lee Seong-yoon (11.69%), candidate Im Mi-ae (5.99%), and candidate Kim Young-ho (3.29%). (순위권 밖으로는 이성윤(11.69%) 후보, 임미애(5.99%) 후보, 김영호(3.29%) 후보가 있다.)

In the combined results for the Jeju and Incheon regions, candidate Kim Min-seok received 47.75%, candidate Jung Cheong-rae 42.08%, and candidate Song Young-gil 10.17% of the votes. (제주·인천 지역 합산 결과, 김민석 후보 47.75%, 정청래 후보 42.08%, 송영길 후보 10.17% 득표율을 얻었다.)

The vote count for party leadership candidates in the Jeju region showed candidate Jung Cheong-rae receiving 6,625 votes (39.89%), candidate Kim Min-seok receiving 8,742 votes (52.64%), and candidate Song Young-gil receiving 1,240 votes (7.47%). (제주 지역에서 당대표 후보 개표결과는 정청래 후보 6625표(39.89%), 김민석 후보는 8742표(52.64%), 송영길 후보 1240표(7.47%)를 얻었다.)

()

In the Incheon region, candidate Jung Cheong-rae received 13,237 votes (43.27%) and candidate Kim Min-seok received 13,795 votes (45.09%). (인천 지역에서는 정청래 후보 1만3237표(43.27%), 김민석 후보 1만3795표(45.09%)를 얻었다.)

After the primary concluded, candidate Jung Cheong-rae met with reporters and said, "It is truly a great relief not to have lost by more today," adding, "Aren't nearly nine out of ten media outlets and broadcasts cheering for the other two (Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil)? In the Honam region, and in Seoul and Gyeonggi, they will bring about a sufficient comeback victory." (정청래 후보는 경선 종료 뒤 기자들과 만나 “오늘 이 정도로 덜 진 것이 정말 큰 다행”이라며 “모든 언론과 방송에서 거의 9 대 1로 두 분(김민석, 송영길)을 응원하지 않나. 호남에서, 그리고 서울 경기에서 충분히 역전승을 시켜 주실 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "No One Should Hesitate to Marry Due to National Policies" (李 대통령 “국가 정책 때문에 결혼 망설이는 일 없어야”)
item.description:
President Lee: "No One Should Hesitate to Marry Due to National Policies" (李 대통령 “국가 정책 때문에 결혼 망설이는 일 없어야”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 8th, "Our young people should never hesitate to get married because of national policies," adding, "If there are any systems you find unreasonable, please feel free to speak up." (이재명 대통령은 “우리 청년들이 국가의 정책 때문에 결혼을 망설이는 일은 결코 없어야 한다”며 “불합리하다 생각하는 제도가 있을 경우 편하게 말씀해주시면 좋겠다”고 8일 말했다.)

On that day, the President shared on X (formerly Twitter) the data titled "22 Marriage Penalties Found Through the Voices of Young People." He also stated, "I have instructed a thorough investigation and report on institutional disadvantages one might face due to marriage," and noted, "We have gathered diverse opinions through youth forums, real estate discussions, and reviews by relevant ministries." (이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 ‘청년들의 목소리로 찾은 결혼 페널티 22개’ 자료를 공유했다. 또 “결혼으로 인해 겪을 수 있는 제도상 불이익을 면밀히 조사해 보고할 것을 지시했다”며 “청년 포럼과 부동산 토론회, 관계부처 검토 등을 통해 다양한 의견을 들었다”고 했다.)

He further explained, "In that process, 22 tasks that directly affect housing and asset building—such as loans, subscription (for new homes), and taxation—were prioritized as proposals." (이어 “그 과정에서 대출, 청약, 세제와 같이 주거와 자산 형성에 직접 영향을 미치는 스물두개 과제가 우선 제안됐다”고 설명했다.)

The document, "22 Marriage Penalties Found Through the Voices of Young People," which appears to have been produced by the presidential office (Cheong Wa Dae), includes demands such as easing income requirements for the Didimdol home purchase loan, easing income requirements for the Buttumok jeonse (deposit) loan, easing income requirements for the Bogumjari loan, expanding eligibility for first-time home purchase loans, expanding the income threshold for the newborn special loan for dual-income couples, and easing subscription requirements for newlywed special supply housing. (청와대가 제작한 것으로 보이는 ‘청년들의 목소리로 찾은 결혼 페널티 22개’ 자료에는 디딤돌 내집마련 소득요건 완화, 버팀목 전세자금대출 소득요건 완화, 보금자리론 소득요건 완화, 생애최초 주택구입자금 대출 신청대상 확대, 신생아 특례대출 맞벌이 소득기준 확대, 신혼부부 특별공급 신혼부부 청약요건 완화 등 요구 사항들이 포함됐다.)

The President said, "I intend to carefully examine each item one by one to see if there are areas needing improvement and whether the measures can be fair and provide practical help to everyone." He added, "I want to listen to the voices of the people and work together to create big and small changes you can truly feel." (이 대통령은 “개선이 필요한 부분이 있는지, 또 그 방안이 모두에게 공정하고 실질적인 도움이 될 수 있을지 하나씩 꼼꼼히 살펴보려 한다”며 “국민 여러분의 목소리를 듣고, 실제 체감하실 수 있는 크고 작은 변화를 함께 만들어가고 싶다”고 했다.)

He also remarked, "I will fulfill the government's responsibility so that marriage can be a hopeful new beginning, not a burden." (그러면서 “결혼이 부담이 아닌 희망찬 새 출발이 될 수 있도록 정부의 책임을 다하겠다”고 하기도 했다.)

item.title: US Deputy Defense Secretary Cites 'Regional War' Concerns, Says 'Reasonable Nuclear Options' Needed (美국방차관, ‘지역 전쟁’ 우려하며 “합리적 핵옵션 필요”)
item.description:
Elbridge Colby, the U.S. Deputy Secretary of Defense for Policy, reportedly emphasized the need to maintain "reasonable nuclear options" at the Strategic Command (STRATCOM) extended deterrence symposium held in Omaha, Nebraska on the 5th, citing the growing trend of interest in small tactical nuclear weapons. Earlier, NBC reported that the Defense Department was discussing a new nuclear strategy placing greater weight on low-yield tactical nuclear weapons. The U.S. nuclear doctrine is currently centered on long-range strategic weapons, and the nuclear posture review could have a significant impact on security in Northeast Asia, including South Korea. Domestically, skepticism remains over the U.S. "extended deterrence (nuclear umbrella)" amid the escalating North Korean nuclear and missile threats. <<> The U.S. defense media outlet Breaking Defense reported on the 7th that it obtained a recording of Colby's closed-door speech, in which he argued for the need for "reasonable nuclear options" while mentioning the expanding interest in small tactical nuclear weapons and the issue of regional wars. Colby said he is more concerned about regional wars than large-scale attacks targeting the United States, referencing scenarios where conventional warfare escalates to limited use of nuclear weapons and leads to further escalation. He also said that a review of the authorities and responsibilities of the Strategic Command commander and the Secretary of Defense regarding U.S. nuclear policy is underway. The outlet reported that Colby repeatedly emphasized the term "options" in his speech but did not provide detailed explanations. STRATCOM is the core functional combatant command that oversees the global operation of nuclear forces and strategic deterrence. It is also tasked with providing extended deterrence capabilities to allies, including South Korea. <<> In a subsequent briefing, STRATCOM commander Richard Correll said that nuclear policy has not changed, but that the issue is being addressed in terms of expanding the options presented to the president. "I view this on a broader scale than just our nuclear capabilities," he said, adding that it is necessary to create "ambiguity" in each theater, and "by doing so, potential adversaries would raise the threshold for considering nuclear use in the theater. The most important thing is deterrence." Citing multiple senior officials, the outlet reported that the Defense Department has begun a review of the U.S. nuclear posture focused on providing the White House with more options, adding that "a conclusion may be reached that more tactical nuclear weapons are needed." <<> While the United States relies on strategic nuclear weapons, China and Russia are accelerating the development of low-yield tactical nuclear weapons that can be used with relatively greater flexibility. There is a dilemma in that if an adversary launches an attack with low-yield tactical nuclear weapons, responding with strategic nuclear weapons would cause catastrophic results, yet there is no appropriate alternative response. If, as Colby believes, the U.S. realigns its nuclear strategy to place greater emphasis on short-range tactical nuclear weapons targeting limited objectives instead of strategic nuclear weapons that are unlikely to be actually used, it could have a significant impact on the defense posture of the Korean Peninsula and the security landscape of South Korea and Japan. There is also the possibility that tactical nuclear weapons, which were completely withdrawn from South Korea in 1991, could be redeployed. U.S. Forces Korea operated various types of tactical nuclear weapons from 1958, with up to 700 deployed at the peak. <<> <<> ☞Strategic Nuclear vs. Tactical Nuclear Weapons <<> Strategic nuclear weapons have yields ranging from hundreds of kilotons (kt) to megatons (Mt) and are designed to destroy broad areas such as enemy territory or national infrastructure. In contrast, tactical nuclear weapons are nuclear weapons that attack military targets in limited areas, such as enemy units or bases, and typically have yields of tens of kilotons or less. While strategic nuclear weapons are "war-prevention" tools based on the principle of mutually assured destruction (MAD)—"if I die, you die too"—tactical nuclear weapons are closer to actual battlefield-use weapons. (엘브리지 콜비 미 국방부 정책 담당 차관이 지난 5일 네브래스카주(州) 오마하에서 열린 전략사령부(STRATCOM) 확장 억제 심포지엄에서 소형 전술핵에 대한 관심이 확대되는 추세를 언급하며 ‘합리적 핵옵션’ 보유에 대한 필요성을 강조한 것으로 전해졌다. 앞서 NBC는 국방부가 저위력 전술핵에 무게를 둔 새로운 핵전략을 논의하고 있다고 보도했다. 미국의 핵교리는 장거리 전략무기 위주로 설정돼 있는데, 핵태세 검토가 한국을 비롯한 동북아 지역 안보에 상당한 영향을 미칠 가능성이 있다. 국내에선 점증하는 북한 핵·미사일 위협 속 미국의 ‘확장 억제(핵우산)’에 대한 의구심이 여전한 상황이다.)

item.title: Now the Enemy of Both Ruling and Opposition Parties... Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho's Dilemma (여야 모두의 적이 됐다... 정성호 법무의 딜레마)
item.description:
"President Lee Jae-myung, who grew up poor and wanted to become a lawyer to make money quickly, considers his meeting with Minister Chung Sung-ho one of the key turning points that opened his eyes to civil society and the labor movement." <<> That is the account of a source who knows well the days when President Lee Jae-myung and Minister of Justice Chung Sung-ho were classmates (18th class) at the Judicial Research and Training Institute. The two have remained close friends for 30 years since, and now serve as president and justice minister, respectively. President Lee came under attack from the former mainstream of the Democratic Party of Korea over prosecutorial reform because Minister Chung has taken the position that the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers should be preserved in the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act. <<> When author Yoo Si-min, on a radio program, criticized President Lee—who appears to oppose the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act—for not stepping forward himself but having Minister Chung represent his position, it can be seen that, given the relationship between the two, there is an underlying suspicion that Chung is someone who speaks for President Lee's stance both publicly and privately. <<> In the first year of the Lee Jae-myung administration, he became the only minister who has become the enemy of both the ruling and opposition parties. On August 4, immediately after the National Assembly passed the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, President Lee told Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho, who had expressed his intention to resign, "Do well and hang in there." As a result, Minister Chung now faces a situation where he must endure attacks from both the ruling and opposition parties alone in the upcoming regular session of the National Assembly. <<> In fact, Minister Chung is said to have not wanted to join the cabinet when the Lee Jae-myung administration was launched. He had even declined the first offer of prime minister under the Lee administration, preferring to help only from the shadows. In the end, he could not ignore the repeated offers and the earnest requests from the presidential office, and it was the position of justice minister that he took on. But this choice has led him to a point where he now wants to leave politics altogether. <<> Volunteering as a 'Shield' Amid Prosecutorial Reform Conflict <<> Inside and outside the Ministry of Justice, officials say that although Minister Chung, who expressed his intent to resign, will continue to serve for the time being, the bigger problem is what comes after his departure. If even he, who voluntarily served as a punching bag between the presidential office, the ruling party, and the opposition, disappears, there will be no one left capable of weathering the aftermath of the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act. <<> Within the Ministry of Justice, the prevailing assessment is that Minister Chung maintained balance and performed his role without incident throughout the process of pushing the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, which was akin to walking a tightrope. In the ruling party, his ally, hardliners instead pressed him fiercely, demanding that the prosecution be uprooted entirely and calling for severe discipline and dismissal. But Minister Chung chose to act as a 'shield' to block political blows himself. He even gently persuaded figures with problematic records to retire quietly without causing disruption to the organization. <<> The same was true in his relations with the prosecution. Even when senior prosecutors circulated a collective letter in protest after the decision to drop the appeal in the 'Daejang-dong case' in November last year, no criticism of Minister Chung personally could be found. A Ministry of Justice official said, "Even on the issue of supplementary investigative powers this time, his sincerity in respecting the prosecution's position and soothing the organization was palpable." <<> His stance of avoiding political strife and seeking bipartisan cooperation was also clear. According to his legislative aides, over the past year, Minister Chung never once mentioned the name of an opposition lawmaker in his official messages. When aides drafted scripts attacking the opposition, he erased all harsh expressions, saying, "It is inappropriate for a minister to directly attack opposition lawmakers." He even referred to the party as 'the opposition' rather than 'the People Power Party.' On July 27, during a question session at the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, when Rep. Park Eun-jung of the Rebuilding Korea Party mentioned a past sexual assault case involving the brother-in-law of Rep. Han Dong-hoon and aggressively pressed him to name "the high-flying brother-in-law of that prosecutor," Minister Chung deflected, saying, "I know, but since you ask suddenly, I can't recall," and refused to utter the name. It was a moment that starkly illustrated his conviction not to be dragged into provocative political warfare. <<> This commitment to bipartisan cooperation stems from his experience in 2014 as the senior deputy floor leader of the then Democratic Party (New Politics Alliance for Democracy). Despite being in a minority with only around 130 seats, he stayed up all night drinking and talking candidly with Saenuri Party senior deputy floor leader Kim Jae-won, ultimately securing the passage of the largest number of bills in history and agreements on three special investigations (Sewol ferry, MB's resource diplomacy, and the Jeong Yoon-hoe documents). It was the greatest pride of his political career. Indeed, Minister Chung is known for his easygoing relationships with senior opposition figures. A senior lawmaker from the People Power Party told Weekly Chosun, "Whether I run for president or Minister Chung does, transcending party lines and considering our human bond, we are close enough that we should help each other." <<> Meanwhile, the internal atmosphere of the Ministry of Justice, which had looked precarious from the outside, changed dramatically. Contrary to the public perception that the Ministry of Justice meant 'prosecution,' Minister Chung instead turned his attention to the ministry's core functions such as corrections, immigration, and crime prevention. As he showed interest in the neglected departments, internal staff morale and satisfaction rose significantly. It got to the point where remarks like "He assigns a lot of work, yet oddly no complaints arise" could be heard in the ministry's hallways. During a visit to Anyang Prison in April with legal affairs reporters, he went into the detention block himself, saying he wanted to experience firsthand the conditions of inmates. A Ministry of Justice official said, "Before, reporters followed the minister wherever he went; now, it's the minister who joins the field sites where reporters go." When former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok resigned recently and Minister Chung was mentioned as a candidate for the next prime minister, officials reportedly lamented, "Are they trying to take our minister away?" That is largely the mood at the Ministry of Justice. It also explains why, when Minister Chung recently expressed his intent to resign, internal officials, instead of criticizing him, simply nodded and said, "He must have been under so much pressure." <<> "I Just Want to Read Books" <<> He recently confided to his aides, "These days, even just talking with the other side gets you attacked and targeted, so it feels like there's less room for a dialogue-and-mediation type politician like me," expressing deep regret, according to reports. In a situation where not only the ruling-opposition confrontation but even communication between the party and the presidential office is faltering, Minister Chung has tried to hold the center, and he has voiced greater concern than anyone about the upcoming party convention and the party's stability. As he gradually loses his footing, he is said to frequently say in private, "I'd rather just read books." <<> He had even declined the prime ministership to help run state affairs, but the political landscape hurtling toward extreme confrontation ultimately handed him the dilemma of resignation. A man who polished his own shoes every morning and emphasized 'politics that doesn't break people.' That is why, upon news of his resignation, employees and aides nodded in understanding rather than criticism—because he had transformed the Ministry of Justice's atmosphere into something unrecognizably warmer. <<> ▷For more articles, see Weekly Chosun. (“가난하게 자라서 빨리 돈을 벌 생각에 변호사가 되려 했던 이재명 대통령에게 시민사회나 노동운동 쪽으로 눈을 뜨게 했던 주요한 계기 중 하나가 정성호 장관과의 만남이다.”)

item.title: “Even the Army University was taken from us before”... Jinhae buzzing over Naval Academy relocation (“과거 육군 대학도 뺏겼는데”... 해사 이전에 들끓는 진해)
item.description:
“The Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries was moved to Busan, which is by the sea, so how does it make sense to move the Naval Academy to Daejeon, which has no sea at all?” (“해양수산부는 바다 옆 부산으로 옮기면서, 해군사관학교를 바다도 없는 대전으로 옮기는 게 말이 되느냐.”)

A field-grade naval officer who went through elementary, middle, and high school in Jinhae, South Gyeongsang Province (now Jinhae-gu, Changwon City), and graduated from the Naval Academy, expressed his frustration this way. Shortly after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration in December of last year, the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries was relocated from Sejong to Busan, which is by the sea — yet the Naval Academy, which opened in Jinhae in 1946 as the “Naval Forces School” and celebrates its 80th anniversary this year, is being moved to Daejeon, which has no sea at all. The mood in Jinhae, the home port of the Republic of Korea Navy, is visibly seething over this government policy. In particular, the old downtown of Jinhae where the Naval Academy is located carries the bitter experience of hollowing out that began after the Army University was taken away to Daejeon in 1996 during the Kim Young-sam administration. Adding to that, the Navy Operations Command also left for Busan in 2007 during the Roh Moo-hyun administration, delivering a fatal blow — and now the Naval Academy is set to be handed over to Daejeon once again. (경남 진해(현 창원시 진해구)에서 초·중·고를 나오고 해군사관학교를 졸업한 한 영관급 해군 장교는 이렇게 토로했다. 이재명 정부 출범 직후인 지난해 12월 세종에 있던 해수부를 바다가 있는 부산으로 내려보냈는데, 1946년 ‘해군병학교’로 진해에서 개교해 올해로 80주년 된 해사를 바다도 없는 대전으로 옮기는 게 말이 되느냐는 얘기다. 이 같은 정부 방침에 대한민국 해군 모항(母港) 진해는 격앙된 분위기가 역력하다. 특히 해사가 자리한 진해 구(舊)도심은 김영삼 정부 때인 1996년 육군대학을 대전에 빼앗긴 후 공동화가 시작된 쓰라린 경험이 있다. 여기에 노무현 정부 때인 2007년 해군작전사령부마저 부산으로 떠나면서 치명타를 입었는데, 해군사관학교를 또다시 대전에 넘겨줄 처지다.)

Following the Army University, even the Naval Academy heads to Daejeon (육군대학 이어 해사마저 대전으로)

If the Naval Academy follows the Army University and moves once more to Jaun-daero, Yuseong, Daejeon, the major naval facilities remaining in Jinhae — which Imperial Japan built as a military port to dominate (鎭) the sea (海) after winning the Russo-Japanese War (1905) — would be limited to the Navy Education Command, Naval Logistics Command, Submarine Command, Navy Deoksan Airfield, Navy Maritime Medical Center, Navy Officers’ Club, Hansan-dae Fitness Center (golf course), and the U.S. Navy Fleet Activities Command (CFAC). In particular, the Naval Academy trains the elite officers who will lead the Republic of Korea Navy, and observers point out that its symbolic weight is incomparable to the Education Command, which handles basic training for enlisted sailors. It was also at the Naval Academy that Lee Ji-ho, son of Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong, held his naval officer commissioning ceremony last December. (육군대학에 이어 해군사관학교마저 재차 대전 유성 자운대로 떠나면 러일전쟁(1905년)에 승전한 일제가 바다(海)를 제압(鎭)할 군항(軍港)으로 조성한 진해에 남는 주요 해군 시설은 해군교육사령부, 군수사령부, 잠수함사령부, 해군 덕산비행장, 해군 해양의료원, 해군회관, 한산대 체력단련장(골프장), 미 해군 함대지원단(CFAC) 정도다. 특히 해사는 대한민국 해군을 이끌고 갈 정예 장교들을 양성한다는 점에서 수병 기초교육을 담당하는 교육사령부와는 비할 바 없이 그 상징성이 크다는 지적이다. 이재용 삼성전자 회장의 아들 이지호씨가 지난해 12월 해군 학사장교 임관식을 가진 곳도 해사다.)

Already, the political circles of Changwon, including Jinhae, are raising voices of opposition across party lines to the Naval Academy relocation. Lee Jong-wook, a People Power Party lawmaker representing the Jinhae district (former head of the Public Procurement Service), began a one-man protest starting July 27 at the Naval Academy’s main gate and at Jinhae-ru in front of the Navy Education Command, taking turns with party-affiliated city and provincial council members. Lee stated, “The Naval Academy first opened on January 17, 1946, as the first of the three service academies, and over the past 80 years has produced more than 10,000 elite officers for the Republic of Korea Navy in Jinhae,” adding, “To move the Naval Academy out of Jinhae after the Navy Operations Command is an act that ignores the long-standing dedication and pride of Jinhae residents.” (이미 진해를 비롯한 창원 지역 정치권도 여야를 막론하고 해사 이전에 일제히 반대 목소리를 내고 있다. 진해 지역구 국회의원인 이종욱 국민의힘 의원(전 조달청장)은 지난 7월 27일부터는 해군사관학교 정문, 해군교육사령부 앞 진해루 등지에서 당 소속 시도의원들과 번갈아 가며 1인 시위에 돌입했다. 이종욱 의원은 “해군사관학교는 1946년 1월 17일 3군 사관학교 중 최초로 개교해 지난 80년간 진해에서 1만여명의 대한민국 해군 정예 장교를 양성해 왔다”며 “해군 작전사에 이어 해사마저 진해에서 이전시키겠다는 것은 진해구민의 오랜 헌신과 자부심을 외면하는 처사”라고 성토했다.)

Even city and provincial council members of the ruling Democratic Party from Jinhae held a press conference on July 30, unusually opposing government policy, stating, “We express deep concern over the push to integrate and relocate the Naval Academy on behalf of Jinhae, the home base of the Republic of Korea Navy and a military port city,” and “When enlisted sailors and warrant officers are trained at the Jinhae Education Command, we must question whether moving only the officer training institution inland reflects the unique nature and professionalism of the Navy.” (심지어 여당인 민주당 진해지역 시·도의원들도 지난 7월 30일 기자회견을 열고 “대한민국 해군의 본거지이자 군항의 도시인 진해를 대표해 해군사관학교 통합·이전 추진에 깊은 우려를 표한다”며 “해군 사병과 준사관을 진해교육사령부에서 양성하는 상황에서 장교 양성 기관만 내륙으로 이전하는 것이 해군의 특수성과 전문성을 반영한 것인지 검토가 필요하다”고 이례적으로 정부 정책에 반기를 든 상태다.)

If the Naval Academy leaves Jinhae following the Navy Operations Command, the old downtown of Jinhae — which once blazed through the night with cadets and sailors out on leave and passes — is expected to head toward virtual collapse. The old downtown of Jinhae, laid out radially from Jungwon Rotary below Jinhae Tower on Jehwsan Mountain (110 meters above sea level), which was built on the site where Imperial Japan erected a monument to its victory in the Russo-Japanese War, once thrived with as many as four movie theaters, including the Marine Theater founded by the Navy. Even during the Korean War, the Korea Military Academy (KMA) moved from Taereung, Seoul, to Jinhae. According to the memoirs of Lee Soon-ja, wife of former President Chun Doo-hwan, it was also in Gyeonghwa-dong, Jinhae — where the Navy Education Command now stands — that she first met then-KMA cadet Chun, as she was the daughter of the KMA chief of staff (General Lee Kyu-dong) at the time. (해군작전사에 이어 해사마저 진해를 떠나면 과거 휴가와 외박을 나온 사관생도와 수병들로 불야성을 이뤘던 진해 구도심은 사실상 몰락 수순을 밟을 것으로 보인다. 과거 일제가 러일전쟁 승전기념탑을 세웠던 자리에 들어선 제황산(해발 110m) 진해탑 아래 중원로터리를 기점으로 방사상으로 조성된 진해 구도심은 한때 해군이 설립한 해양극장을 비롯해 영화관만 4곳에 달할 정도로 흥성했다. 6·25전쟁 와중에는 육군사관학교도 서울 태릉에서 진해로 옮겨왔다. 전두환 전 대통령의 부인 이순자 여사 회고록에 따르면, 당시 육사 참모장(이규동 장군)의 딸이었던 이순자 여사가 육사 생도였던 전 전 대통령을 처음 만난 곳도 지금의 해군교육사령부가 있는 진해 경화동이었다.)

But the old downtown of Jinhae has long been reeling from three consecutive shocks: the Army University relocation (1996), the relocation of Jinhae City Hall (now the district office) (2004), and the relocation of the Navy Operations Command (2007). More than 30 years after the Army University left for Daejeon, the former Army University site in Yeojwa-dong, still referred to by its abbreviation “Yukdae,” remains mostly vacant land. After being considered as a baseball stadium site following the 2010 merger of Masan, Changwon, and Jinhae — a plan that fell through — the site was rezoned for research and development, but little progress has been made for decades. Jinhae Central Market, the largest permanent market in Jinhae located south of the nearly abandoned Jinhae Line railway tracks south of the Army University site, has long been deserted. An apartment complex of 2,638 units (Changwon Mega City Xi & Wéve) is under construction just east of the Army University site, but occupancy is not expected to begin until 2029. (하지만 진해 구도심은 육군대학 이전(1996년), 진해시청(현 구청) 이전(2004년), 해군작전사령부 이전(2007년) 등 3연속 충격파로 휘청인 지 오래다. 육군대학이 대전으로 떠난 지 30년이 넘는 지금까지 ‘육대’란 약칭으로 불리는 여좌동 육군대학 일대는 아직도 대부분 공터로 남아있다. 2010년 마산·창원·진해 통합 후 한때 야구장 부지로 검토됐다가 무산된 이후, 연구개발 부지로 용도를 틀었지만 수십 년째 별다른 진척이 없다. 육대 부지 남쪽의 사실상 폐선된 진해선 철길 남쪽의 진해 최대 상설시장인 진해중앙시장도 파리를 날린 지 오래다. 육대 부지 바로 동쪽에 2638가구 아파트(창원메가시티 자이&위브)를 신축 중이지만, 입주는 오는 2029년에나 시작될 전망이다.)

If the Naval Academy relocates as well, the impact is expected to reach even the Jinhae Intercity Bus Terminal, one of the key facilities remaining in the old downtown. Located right next to the Naval Academy’s main gate, the terminal near Namwon Rotary — where a monument bears the poem handwritten by Baekbeom Kim Gu (“Seohae eoryongdong maengsan chomokji”: Pledging by the sea, fish and dragons are moved; vowing by the mountain, even grass and trees understand), written when he visited the Jinhae Coast Guard unit in 1946, right after liberation — has relied on a significant share of passenger demand from Naval Academy cadets and their visitors. If the Naval Academy leaves Jinhae, talk is that the closure of the intercity bus terminal, like Jinhae Station which became effectively defunct when train service ended in 2015, is only a matter of time. (해사마저 이전하면 구도심에 남은 주요 시설 중 하나인 진해 시외버스터미널까지 여파가 미칠 전망이다. 광복 직후인 1946년, 진해 해안경비대를 방문한 백범 김구가 ‘서해어룡동 맹산초목지(바다에 두고 서약하니 물고기와 용이 감동하고, 산을 두고 맹세하니 초목이 알아준다)’라고 쓴 친필 시비가 서 있는 남원로터리 인근 진해 시외버스터미널은 해사 정문 바로 옆에 있어 해사 생도와 면회객들에게 여객수요 상당 부분을 기대왔다. 해사가 진해를 떠나면 2015년 기차가 끊어지며 사실상 폐역이 된 진해역처럼 시외버스터미널 폐쇄 역시 시간문제라는 얘기도 들린다.)

Hwang Ki-cheol, the “Hero of Aden,” in an awkward spot (곤혹스러운 ‘아덴만 영웅’ 황기철)

The Naval Academy relocation is expected to have a considerable impact on Navy-related sentiment among voters in Jinhae. In particular, Hwang Ki-cheol, former Chief of Naval Operations who serves as the Democratic Party’s district committee chair, shows clear signs of discomfiture. A native of Jinhae who graduated from Jinhae High School and the Naval Academy (Class 32), Hwang previously served in key Navy posts including Commander of the Jinhae Naval Base, Commander of the Navy Operations Command, Superintendent of the Naval Academy, Chief of Naval Operations, and Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs. Despite running under the Democratic Party banner in the strongly conservative-leaning Jinhae, he came close to winning in both the 2020 and 2024 general elections with nearly 50% of the vote but fell short both times. In the last election, the margin was just 497 votes. One Navy non-commissioned officer working in Jinhae said, “Current People Power Party lawmaker Lee Jong-wook is a former Army enlisted soldier,” and added, “In the last election, a considerable number of Navy personnel supported former Chief of Naval Operations Hwang Ki-cheol, who successfully led the ‘Aden operation (anti-piracy mission off Somalia)’ during his time as Operations Command commander.” (해사 이전은 진해 지역의 해군 표심에도 상당한 영향을 미칠 것으로 보인다. 특히 민주당 지역위원장을 맡고 있는 황기철 전 해군참모총장은 곤혹스러운 표정이 역력하다. 진해 출신으로 진해고, 해사(32기)를 졸업한 황기철 전 처장은 해군 진해기지사령관, 해군작전사령관, 해군사관학교장, 해군참모총장, 국가보훈처장(장관급) 등 해군 요직을 두루 거쳤다. 이에 보수표심이 강한 진해에서 민주당 간판을 달고서도 2020년과 2024년 두 차례 총선에서 50%에 가까운 득표를 했지만 석패한 바 있다. 지난 총선 때 표차는 497표에 그쳤다. 진해서 근무하는 한 해군 부사관은 “이종욱 현 국민의힘 의원은 육군 일반병 출신”이라며 “지난 총선 때 해군에서는 작전사령관 시절 ‘아덴만 작전(소말리아 해적퇴치)’을 성공시킨 황기철 전 총장을 지지한 사람들이 상당했다”고 말했다.)

Yet, as he eyes a comeback in the 2028 general election, the Democratic administration has essentially dropped a bombshell comparable to the Navy Operations Command relocation. However, since the integration of the service academies was a campaign pledge by President Lee Jae-myung and is a matter being pushed by the current Democratic administration, he is not in a position to openly complain. He has thus limited himself to conveying his views through meetings with Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek, Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do, National Assembly Defense Committee Chairman Jin Seong-jun, First Deputy National Security Adviser Kang Geon-jak, and Senior Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo. Former Chief of Staff Hwang recently stated, “The news that the Naval Academy may move to Daejeon has soured public sentiment,” and expressed hope that “it will remain in Jinhae, the Navy’s city.” A source in Jinhae’s political circles noted, “Former Chief of Staff Hwang was leading significantly in exit polls in the last election but was overtaken at the very end,” adding, “If the Naval Academy relocation becomes a reality, the 2028 election could become even more difficult for him.” (한데 오는 2028년 총선 때 재기를 노리는 상황에서 민주당 정권에서 해군작전사 이전에 버금가는 폭탄을 터뜨린 셈이다. 하지만 사관학교 통합은 이재명 대통령의 대선 공약이고, 민주당 정권에서 추진 중인 사안이라 대놓고 볼멘소리를 할 처지도 아니다. 이에 안규백 국방부 장관, 한병도 민주당 원내대표, 진성준 국회 국방위원장, 강건작 국가안보실 1차장, 홍익표 정무수석 등을 두루 만나 의견을 전달하는 수준에 그치고 있다. 황 전 총장은 최근 “해사가 대전으로 옮길 거라는 소식에 시민들의 민심이 좋지 않다”며 “해군의 도시 진해에 그대로 존치되길 기대한다”는 입장을 밝혔다. 진해 지역 정치권의 한 관계자는 “황기철 전 총장은 지난 총선 때 출구조사에서 크게 이기고도 마지막에 역전패당했다”며 “해사 이전이 현실화되면 오는 2028년 총선은 더 어려워질 수도 있다”고 지적했다.)

item.title: "He Should Have Made Bush Apologize Immediately"…The Moment a US Ambassador Regretted for Life (“부시가 즉각 사과하게 했어야 했다”…美대사가 평생 후회한 순간)
item.description:
<Continuing from last week's 'The Failure of Hubbard That Ambassador Steel Should Remember'> ( <지난주 ‘스틸 美대사가 새겨야 할 허바드의 실패’에 이어서 계속됩니다>)

In November 2002, the US military court in South Korea acquitted, one after another, the two US soldiers responsible for the deaths of Hyo-soon and Mi-seon. Immediately following the verdicts, the two soldiers departed for the United States. The US explained this as a normal judicial procedure under the Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA) between South Korea and the US. However, a significant number of South Koreans interpreted the consecutive acquittals and the soldiers' departure as America's "evasion of responsibility." (2002년 11월 주한미군 군사법원은 효순·미선 양 사망 사건을 일으킨 미군 병사 두 명에게 잇따라 무죄를 선고했습니다. 판결 직후 두 병사는 곧바로 미국으로 출국했습니다. 미국은 이를 한미주둔군지위협정(SOFA)에 따른 정상적인 사법 절차라고 설명했습니다. 그러나 상당수 한국 국민은 두 병사의 잇따른 무죄 판결과 출국을 미국의 ‘책임 회피’로 받아들였습니다.)

Moreover, the verdicts came with less than a month left before the presidential election. The left-wing camp began actively leveraging the incident as a political issue, linking it to anti-American sentiment. (더욱이 대선을 불과 한 달도 남겨 놓지 않은 시점에 문제의 판결이 나왔습니다. 좌파 진영은 이 사건을 반미 정서와 연결시키며 정치적 이슈로 적극 활용하기 시작했습니다.)

The US Belatedly Moves to Manage the Situation Politically (뒤늦게 정치적 수습 나선 미국)

The US belatedly moved to manage the situation politically. US Ambassador to South Korea Thomas Hubbard held a press conference on November 27, 2002, announcing that President George W. Bush had requested him to convey deep condolences and regret to the families of the two middle school girls, the South Korean government, and the South Korean people. He also conveyed President Bush's intention to cooperate closely with the South Korean government to ensure such an accident never happens again. (미국은 뒤늦게 정치적 수습에 나섰습니다. 토머스 허바드 주한미대사는 2002년 11월 27일 기자회견을 열어 조지 W 부시 대통령이 두 여중생의 유가족과 대한민국 정부, 그리고 한국 국민에게 깊은 애도와 유감의 뜻을 전해 달라는 요청을 했다고 발표했습니다. 아울러 같은 사고가 다시는 발생하지 않도록 한국 정부와 긴밀히 협력하겠다는 부시 대통령의 뜻도 함께 전달했습니다.)

However, that day's announcement failed to move the South Korean people. What South Korean society had expected was not an apology conveyed through the US ambassador, but a public apology delivered directly by President Bush to the South Korean people. (그러나 이날의 발표는 한국 국민의 마음을 움직이지 못했습니다. 한국 사회가 기대했던 것은 주한 미대사를 통한 사과 전달이 아니라 부시 대통령이 직접 한국 국민에게 공개적으로 사과하는 모습이었습니다.)

Subsequently, on December 13, President Bush called President Kim Dae-jung directly to express "deep sorrow and regret" over the deaths of the two girls. This also was not a public, direct apology to the South Korean people, and it was too late to reverse the already widespread anti-American sentiment. (이후 부시 대통령은 12월 13일 김대중 대통령에게 직접 전화해 두 여중생의 죽음에 대해 ‘깊은 슬픔과 유감을 표명했습니다. 이것 역시도 한국 국민을 향한 공개적인 직접 사과 형식은 아니었으며 이미 확산된 반미 여론을 되돌리기에는 늦었습니다.)

In retrospect, the US adhered consistently to legal procedures and diplomatic conventions throughout the girls' deaths incident. South Korean society, on the other hand, perceived it as a matter where national sentiment and politics were intertwined. This gap was never bridged, and the anti-American left-wing camp came to dominate that space. (돌이켜 보면 미국은 여중생 사망 사건에서 끝까지 법률적 절차와 외교적 관례를 중시했습니다. 반면 한국 사회는 국민 감정과 정치가 결합된 문제로 인식했습니다. 이 간극은 끝내 해소되지 않았고, 미국에 비판적인 좌파 진영이 이 공간을 지배했습니다.)

"I Should Have Strongly Demanded a Direct Apology from President Bush" (“부시 대통령의 직접 사과를 강하게 요구했어야 했다”)

For Ambassador Hubbard, this incident remained his greatest regret during his diplomatic career. At a meeting with reporters ahead of his departure in 2004, he confessed, "Among my 2 years and 11 months in office, the girls' deaths case was the most difficult." He said his biggest regret was failing to properly convey to the South Korean people how deeply the US regretted the incident. (허바드 대사에게 이 사건은 자신의 외교관 생활 중 가장 큰 아쉬움으로 남았습니다. 2004년 이임을 앞두고 기자들과 만난 자리에서 그는 “2년 11개월의 재임 기간 가운데 여중생 사망 사건이 가장 힘들었다”고 털어놓았습니다. 미국이 이 사건을 얼마나 안타깝게 생각하는지를 한국 국민에게 제대로 전달하지 못한 점을 가장 아쉽게 생각한다고 말했습니다.)

His regrets are documented in detail in the 'Ambassador's Memoir' published by the Korea Economic Institute (KEI) in 2009. (그의 후회는 2009년 한미경제연구소(KEI)가 발간한 ‘대사들의 회고록(Ambassador’s Memoir)’에 상세하게 기록돼 있습니다. .)

"My biggest regret in handling this case is that I did not press hard enough for an apology from President Bush immediately after the incident. General LaPorte (the USFK commander) and I recommended a statement from the top levels in Washington, but when it didn't come immediately, we focused on what we could do locally. There was an initial misunderstanding because public anger was minimal for two weeks after the incident until the World Cup ended. (“이 사건을 처리하면서 내가 가장 후회하는 것은 사건 발생 직후 (부시) 대통령의 사과를 충분히 강력하게 요구하지 못했다는 것이다. (주한미군사령관인) 라포트 장군과 저는 워싱턴 최고위층의 성명을 권고했지만, 즉시 나오지 않자 우리는 지역적으로 할 수 있는 일에 집중했다. 사건 발생 후 2주가 지나 월드컵이 끝날 때까지 대중의 분노가 미미했던 것에 처음에는 오해가 있었다. )

I expected that a Korean reporter in Washington would ask a question that would elicit an apology from the White House spokesman or the President himself. I still don't understand why that didn't happen. In any case, once public opinion began to boil over, the negative reaction toward the US was enormous." (나는 한국 기자가 워싱턴에서 백악관 대변인이나 대통령 본인의 사과를 이끌어낼 만한 질문을 할 것이라고 예상했다. 그런 일이 일어나지 않은 것이 아직도 이해가 되지 않는다. 어쨌든 일단 여론이 들끓기 시작하자 (미국에)부정적인 반응은 엄청났다." )

Hubbard was not the only one to make such an assessment. Russell Honoré, who served as commander of the US 2nd Infantry Division in South Korea at the time, also recalled that the US response to the incident was problematic. Now retired and working as a disaster expert, he mentioned the incident in his book 'Survival.' (허바드만 이런 평가를 한 것은 아닙니다. 같은 시 기 주한미군 2사단장이었던 러셀 아너레이도 이 사건에 대한 미국의 대응에 문제가 있었다고 회고했습니다. 퇴직 후 재난(災難) 전문가로 활동 중인 그는 자신의 책 ‘생존(Survival)’에서 이 사건을 언급했습니다.)

"After the girls' deaths, I entrusted the 2nd Division's statement to a public affairs major, but this officer adopted a posture of explanation rather than apology. This ultimately sent the wrong message to Koreans and led to nationwide protests. It was only then that I realized my mistake, but it was too late." (“여중생 사망 사건 발생 후 2사단의 입장 발표를 공보 담당 소령에게 맡겼는데 이 장교는 사죄하는 태도가 아니라 해명하는 자세를 보였다. 이는 결국 한국인들에게 잘못된 메시지를 주게 됐고 전국적인 시위로 이어졌다. 그때서야 내 실수를 깨달았지만 너무 늦었다.”)

In the end, both the military and diplomatic authorities belatedly acknowledged that the US had failed more in its initial response than in the incident itself. (결국 미국은 사건 자체보다 초기 대응에서 더 큰 실패를 범했다는 점을 군과 외교 당국 모두 뒤늦게 인정한 셈입니다.)

Hubbard's View of the 2002 Presidential Election (허바드가 본 2002년 대선)

In his memoir, Hubbard assessed that the Hyo-soon and Mi-seon incident also affected the presidential election. (허바드는 회고록에서 효순·미선 사건이 대통령 선거에도 영향을 미쳤다고 평가했습니다.)

"There is little doubt that the anger of the South Korean people over the deaths of the two young girls and America's response influenced Roh Moo-hyun's victory in the presidential election." (“두 어린 소녀의 죽음과 미국의 대응에 대한 한국 국민의 분노가 노무현 후보의 대통령 당선에 영향을 미쳤다는 것은 의심의 여지가 거의 없다.”)

Interestingly, he criticized Lee Hoi-chang, the conservative candidate, more harshly than candidate Roh Moo-hyun. (흥미로운 것은 그가 노무현 후보보다 보수 진영 후보였던 이회창 후보를 더 강하게 비판했다는 점입니다.)

"Few Koreans know that it was Lee Hoi-chang, Roh Moo-hyun's opponent, who participated in the candlelight vigils in the final stages of the campaign and signed the petition demanding an apology from President Bush and SOFA revision. He put on a big show by summoning me to express his grievances." (“선거 막판 촛불 시위에 참여하고 부시 대통령의 사과와 SOFA 개정을 요구하는 청원서에 서명한 사람이 바로 노무현의 상대 후보였던 이회창이라는 사실을 아는 한국인은 거의 없다. 그는 자신의 불만을 표현하기 위해 나를 소환하는 큰 쇼(big show)를 벌였다.”)

Roh Moo-hyun Politically Exploiting Anti-American Sentiment (반미 정서를 정치적으로 활용한 노무현)

Hubbard's analysis is confirmed by the election process itself. On December 7, 2002, ten days before the presidential election, Democratic Party candidate Roh Moo-hyun placed advertisements using candlelight imagery on the front pages of all major national newspapers. (허바드의 분석은 당시 선거 과정에서도 그대로 확인됩니다. 대통령 선거를 열흘 앞둔 2002년 12월 7일, 민주당 노무현 후보는 전국 주요 일간지 1면에 촛불 이미지를 활용한 광고를 실었습니다.)

"I have never been more ashamed to be a politician than I am now. Mi-seon, Hyo-soon, if you are reborn, shout it out with all your might: Republic of Korea! I will surely create a new Republic of Korea." (“정치인이라는 것이 지금처럼 부끄러울 때가 없습니다. 미선아, 효순아, 다음에 다시 태어나거든 마음껏 외쳐라, 대한민국! 반드시 새로운 대한민국을 만들겠습니다.”)

This was a representative example of directly linking the anti-American sentiment triggered by the US military armored vehicle accident to his election message. Candidate Roh also sparked controversy during the campaign with remarks such as "I won't go to America" and "So what if I'm anti-American?" (이는 주한 미군 장갑차 사고로 촉발된 반미 정서를 선거 메시지와 직접 연결한 대표적인 사례였습니다. 노 후보는 선거 과정에서 “미국에 가지 않겠다” “반미면 어떠냐”는 발언으로도 논란을 일으켰습니다.)

Lessons Ambassador Michelle Steel Should Take to Heart (미셸 스틸 대사가 새겨야 교훈)

Hubbard's failure in 2002 holds many implications for Michelle Steel, the newly appointed Korean-American ambassador. Observing the nine US ambassadors to South Korea over the past two decades, excluding Steel herself, four conditions emerge for success as US Ambassador to South Korea. (2002년 허바드의 실패는 최근 새롭게 부임한 한국계 미셸 스틸 대사에게 많은 것을 시사합니다. 지난 20여 년 동안 스틸 대사를 제외한 9명의 미국대사를 지켜보며 내린 주한미국대사의 성공 조건은 네 가지입니다.)

First is a measured message based on professional knowledge. While principles regarding the ROK-US alliance, North Korea, and China must be clear, expressions that could spread as anti-American controversy in South Korean politics require particular caution. One must recognize that the weight of speaking as a US federal congresswoman is entirely different from speaking as ambassador extraordinary and plenipotentiary. At a time when efforts to reach the South Korean people daily through media and social media are more important than ever, sensitive issues between the two countries should be thoroughly understood in advance, and appropriate messages must be delivered at the right time. (첫째는 전문적인 지식을 바탕으로 한 절제된 메시지입니다. 한미동맹, 북한, 중국 문제에 대한 원칙은 분명해야 하지만, 한국 정치에서 반미 논란으로 확산될 수 있는 표현은 각별히 신중해야 합니다. 미국의 연방 하원의원으로 발언할 때와 특명전권대사로 발언할 때의 무게는 전혀 다르다는 점을 인식해야 합니다. 매일같이 언론과 SNS를 통해 한국 국민에게 다가가는 노력이 어느 때 보다 중요한 시기에 한미간의 민감한 현안을 평소 깊이 있게 숙지 후, 적시에 적절한 메시지를 발신해야 합니다.)

Second is a deep understanding of Korean society. Ambassador Steel was born in Seoul and attended Jungang Girls' Middle School before immigrating to the US via Japan. The fact that she was born in Korea does not mean she knows today's Korean society well. Over the past half-century, Korea's politics, media, and the way public opinion is formed have completely changed. In Korea, national sentiment often moves before legal judgment. The girls' deaths incident was the most symbolic example of this. (둘째는 한국 사회에 대한 깊은 이해입니다. 스틸 대사는 서울에서 태어나 중앙여중에 다니다 일본을 거쳐 미국으로 이민을 떠났습니다. 한국에서 태어났다는 사실이 지금의 한국 사회를 잘 안다는 의미는 아닙니다. 지난 반세기 동안 한국은 정치와 언론, 여론 형성 방식이 완전히 달라졌습니다. 한국은 법률적 판단보다 국민 감정이 먼저 움직이는 경우도 적지 않습니다. 여중생 사망 사건은 이를 가장 상징적으로 보여준 사례였습니다.)

Former Ambassador Alexander Vershbow was a veteran diplomat who had served as ambassador to Russia, but during the 2008 US beef protests, his remark that he hoped "Koreans would learn more about the science and facts regarding US beef" was interpreted as "Koreans should study science more," drawing fierce backlash. It was a case demonstrating that how the South Korean people receive the US ambassador's remarks can be crucial. (알렉산더 버시바우 전 대사는 주러시아 대사를 거친 베테랑 외교관이었지만 2008년 미국산 쇠고기 파동 당시 ‘한국인들이 미국산 쇠고기에 관한 과학과 사실을 더 알게 되기를 바란다’고 한 발언이 ‘한국인들은 과학을 더 공부해야 한다’는 취지로 받아들여지면서 거센 반발을 샀습니다. 한국 국민이 미국 대사의 발언을 어떻게 받아들이느냐가 중요할 수 있다는 사실을 보여주는 사례였습니다.)

Third is the ability to communicate directly with the White House. Issues that shake the entire ROK-US relationship, like the Hyo-soon and Mi-seon case, ultimately require a decision from the US President. If necessary, the political capacity to swiftly elicit messages from the White House is an important asset for an ambassador. Ambassador Steel's husband, attorney Sean Steel, served as chairman of the California Republican Party and has long been an active figure within the party as a Republican National Committeeman. Sean Steel's extensive Republican network could aid communication with the White House, and it seems necessary to utilize it well without putting her husband in the spotlight. (셋째는 백악관과 직통하는 소통 능력입니다. 효순·미선 사건처럼 한미관계 전체를 흔드는 사안은 결국 미국 대통령의 결단이 있어야 합니다. 필요하다면 백악관의 메시지를 신속하게 이끌어낼 수 있는 정치적 역량이 대사의 중요한 자산입니다. 스틸 대사는 남편인 숀 스틸 변호사가 캘리포니아 공화당 의장을 지냈고 오랫동안 공화당 전국위원으로 활동해온 당내 중진 인사입니다. 숀 스틸의 폭넓은 공화당 네트워크는 백악관과의 소통에 도움이 될 수 있는데, 남편을 드러내지 않으면서 잘 활용하는게 필요해 보입니다.)

Fourth is crisis management capability in the event of an emergency. North Korean provocations, serious anti-American protests, and other issues can occur simultaneously at any time. Due to the usual 14-hour time difference between Seoul and Washington DC, important matters are often not handled in a timely manner, causing situations to escalate. During former President Yoon Suk Yeol's absurd martial law declaration on December 3, 2024, Ambassador Philip Goldberg was caught off guard, unable to understand the background. The ambassador must be equipped with the capacity to independently and swiftly handle situations affecting the ROK-US relationship. (넷째는 긴급 사태 발생시 위기관리 능력입니다. 북한의 도발, 심각한 반미 시위 등은 언제든지 동시 다발적으로 발생할 수 있습니다. 서울과 워싱턴 DC는 평소 14시간의 시차로 인해 중요한 사건을 제 때 처리하지 못해 일이 커지는 경우가 적지 않습니다. 2024년 12월 3일 윤석열 당시 대통령의 황당한 비상 계엄 당시 필립 골드버그 대사는 그 배경을 알지 못해 속수무책이었습니다. 한미 관계에 영향을 주는 사태가 발생시 독자적으로 신속하게 처리하는 역량을 갖춰야 합니다.)

It is hoped that Ambassador Steel—who carries the symbolic significance of being the first Korean-American female US ambassador to South Korea, born in Seoul as the daughter of displaced persons—will learn from the successes and failures of her predecessors and be remembered as a successful ambassador who advanced the ROK-US alliance to the next level. (‘실향민의 딸로 서울에서 태어난 한국계 첫 여성 주한 미국대사’라는 상징성을 가진 스틸 대사가 역대 대사들의 성공과 실패를 교훈삼아 한미동맹을 한 단계 더 발전시킨 성공한 대사로 기억되기를 바랍니다.)

item.title: Victim of "Pivot Kick" Attack: "Expressions Like 'Go to Hell'... A Minor Issue Compared to the Side Effects of Abolishing Supplementary Investigation" (돌려차기 피해자 “지옥 가라는 표현... 보완수사 폐지 부작용 비하면 약과”)
item.description:
The perpetrator appeared holding a convenience store plastic bag. And he left the scene empty-handed. The police never asked about that bag. This is what Kim Jin-ju (pseudonym), the victim of the Busan "pivot kick" attack, revealed shortly after the bill to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority passed the National Assembly threshold. (가해자는 편의점 봉투 하나를 들고 나타났다. 그리고 빈손으로 현장을 떠났다. 경찰은 그 봉투에 대해 묻지 않았다. 부산 돌려차기 사건 피해자 김진주(가명)씨가 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 법안이 국회 문턱을 넘은 직후 털어놓은 얘기다.)

Given the circumstances of that day, what he bought at the convenience store could have been crucial evidence revealing the motive for the crime or the perpetrator's state of mind. But as the police missed what was in the plastic bag and where it went, the identity of the item inside that bag was buried forever. By the time he visited the convenience store five months after the incident to request CCTV footage and purchase records, too much time had already passed. (그날의 상황을 감안해보면 편의점에서 그가 무엇을 샀는지는 범행 동기나 가해자의 상태를 알 수 있는 중요한 증거가 될 수도 있었다. 하지만 경찰이 비닐봉투에 무엇이 들었고, 행방이 어떻게 됐는지를 놓치면서 그 비닐봉투 속 물건의 정체는 영원히 묻혔다. 그가 사건 발생 5개월 후 편의점을 찾아가 CCTV와 구매 내역을 요청했을 땐, 이미 시간이 너무 지나 있었다.)

Kim recently created a new account on X (formerly Twitter) to deliver her voice directly to President Lee Jae-myung. This was based on the fact that the president actively uses social media. As soon as she opened the account, her followers grew to 29,000. Although she hasn't received any particular response yet, Kim continues to leave comments on the president's posts related to his overseas trips. Regarding the president's current overseas tour, Kim said, "It only looks like he's avoiding the issue." (김씨는 최근 이재명 대통령에게 직접 목소리를 전달하기 위해 엑스(X·옛 트위터) 계정을 새로 만들었다. 이 대통령이 소셜미디어(SNS)를 활발히 이용한다는 점에 착안한 것이다. 계정을 개설하자마자 팔로어가 2만9000명까지 늘었다. 아직 별다른 답은 받지 못했지만, 김씨는 대통령의 해외순방 관련 게시물에도 계속 댓글을 남기고 있다. 대통령이 현재 해외 순방 중인 것을 두고 김씨는 “문제를 회피하는 것으로밖에 안 보인다”고도 했다.)

Weekly Chosun met Kim on the night of August 3rd at an office in Seomyeon, Busan. Kim said she had received an urgent request for a National Assembly briefing that evening from the office of Representative Han Dong-hoon, an independent whose constituency is Busan, and that she planned to head up to Seoul the next day. "I want to secure the president's veto by any means necessary," she said, expressing her desperate feelings. However, the very next day, August 4th, President Lee Jae-myung effectively refused to exercise the veto. (주간조선은 지난 8월 3일 밤 부산 서면의 한 사무실에서 김씨를 만났다. 김씨는 이날 저녁 부산이 지역구인 한동훈 무소속 의원실로부터 급히 국회간담회 요청을 받고, 내일 서울로 올라갈 예정이라고 했다. 그는 “어떤 짓을 해서라도 대통령 거부권을 얻어내고 싶다”며 절박한 심경을 토로했다. 하지만 다음 날인 8월 4일, 이재명 대통령은 거부권 행사를 사실상 거부한 상태다.)

That day, Kim said, "Recently, I've been receiving a lot of contact from people who identify themselves as Democratic Party members." She continued, "They say things like 'We're sorry,' 'There are lawmakers within the party who oppose this too,' and 'I don't understand what the hardcore supporters are that they're going this far.'" She then asked back, "What is the ban on supplementary investigation even for?" The following is a Q&A with Kim. (이날 김씨는 “최근 민주당원이라고 밝힌 이들로부터도 연락을 많이 받는다”며 “‘죄송하다’ ‘당내에도 반대하는 의원들이 있다’ ‘강성 지지층이 뭐길래 이렇게까지 하는지 모르겠다’는 내용”이라며 “무엇을 위한 보완수사 금지인가”라고 되물었다. 다음은 김씨와의 일문일답.)

The bill to abolish the supplementary investigation authority passed the National Assembly plenary session. How do you feel? (보완수사권 폐지 법안이 국회 본회의를 통과했다. 심경이 어떤가.)

"There's an indescribable frustration. Until now, I was a 'visible victim,' so I was careful that my remarks might seem to speak for other victims. But with this situation, I felt I absolutely had to stop it, and I couldn't hold back, so I started pouring out my feelings on social media." (“말로 다 할 수 없는 답답함이 있다. 그동안은 ‘보이는 피해자’였다 보니 제 발언이 마치 다른 피해자들의 의견을 대변하는 것처럼 비칠까 조심스러웠는데, 이번 사태만큼은 꼭 막아야겠다는 생각에 참지 못하고 SNS에 심경을 쏟아내기 시작했다.”)

In a way, this could potentially create more victims than martial law. (어찌보면 계엄보다 더 많은 피해자들을 낳을 수도 있을 것 같다. )

"In reality, I think this is a problem that can harm far more people than martial law. It's just being treated lightly because there's no immediate physical damage visible." (“실제로는 계엄보다 훨씬 더 많은 사람을 다치게 할 수 있는 문제라고 생각한다. 물리적인 피해가 당장 안 보인다는 이유로 가볍게 여겨지고 있을 뿐이다. ”)

Why did you use words like "Go to hell" toward Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min? (김용민 민주당 의원에게 “지옥에나 가세요”라는 표현까지 쓴 까닭은. )

"Considering the side effects, that's not even a harsh expression. Before the bill even passed, it was clear what the negative impact would be. This isn't a problem caused by bad or corrupt police—it's the difference between having 'two chances to filter things out' and 'only one chance.' People who couldn't possibly be unaware of this have turned a blind eye to fit their own political logic." (“부작용을 생각하면 그리 심한 표현도 아니다. 법안 통과 전부터 악영향이 명백하다는 것을 알고 있었다. 이는 경찰이 나빠서, 혹은 부패해서 생기는 문제가 아니라 ‘두 번 걸러낼 기회’와 ‘한 번뿐인 기회’의 차이다. 이걸 모를 리 없는 사람들이 본인들의 정치적 논리를 맞추기 위해 눈을 가린 것이다.”)

What role did the prosecution play in your case? (본인 사건에서 검찰이 어떤 역할을 했나.)

"At the police investigation stage, it was only referred to the prosecution as a case of grievous bodily harm. During the prosecution's supplementary investigation, sexual offense charges were additionally uncovered, and the charge was changed to attempted murder. If the supplementary investigation authority hadn't existed, and if it hadn't been reported in the media, my case would have already ended at that stage." (“경찰 수사 단계에서는 중상해 사건으로만 송치됐다. 검찰의 보완수사 과정에서 성범죄 혐의가 추가로 드러났고, 살인미수로 죄명이 바뀌었다. 만약 보완수사권이 없었다면, 그리고 언론에 알려지지 않았다면 제 사건은 이미 그 단계에서 끝났을 것이다.”)

What specifically were the shortcomings during the police investigation stage? (경찰 수사 단계에서 구체적으로 아쉬웠던 부분은.)

"When the police conducted a forensic examination, they found that the perpetrator had searched for the words 'rape' and 'murder.' That's practically a confession, isn't it? But even so, when he denied it, they just let it go. The most absurd thing was that, even though I had obtained a medical opinion on dissociative amnesia because I clearly couldn't remember, the police asked me, 'Do you think you were a victim of a sexual crime?' Even if I said 'yes,' they could hardly believe it—would they believe me if I said 'no'? I felt like they were shifting the responsibility onto me." (“경찰이 포렌식 검사를 해보니 가해자가 ‘강간’, ‘살인’이라고 검색을 했더라. 사실상 자백이지 않나. 그런데도 가해자가 아니라고 부인하니까 그냥 넘어갔다. 제일 황당했던 건, 제가 분명히 기억이 안 난다고 해서 해리성 기억장애 소견서까지 받아놨는데도 경찰이 저한테 ‘성범죄 피해를 당한 것 같냐’고 묻더라. ‘그렇다’고 해도 믿을 수 없는 상황인데, ‘아니다’라고 하면 믿을 것인가. 내게 책임을 떠넘기는 것 같다고 느꼈다.”)

"Also, the police didn't photograph my injuries properly. When I was found, there was only one photo taken from a distance, which made forensic analysis difficult. They should have taken more detailed photos, but there was just that one. They also didn't properly obtain witness statements. They should have thoroughly questioned the witnesses and taken formal statements about what had happened, but instead they just asked simple questions on the spot and moved on. The witnesses had even made voice recordings and video of the situation—if it weren't for them, we wouldn't have had evidence at all." (“이외에도 경찰이 제 피해 상태를, 몸을 찍어가지 않았다. 제가 발견됐을 당시 사진이 멀리서 찍은 것 하나밖에 없어서 감식이 어려웠다. 좀 더 면밀히 찍었어야 하는데, 딱 한 장뿐이더라. 목격자 증언도 제대로 얻지 않았다. 어떤 상황이었는지 면밀히 물어보고 진술을 받았어야 하는데, 그러지 않고 현장에서 간단한 질문만 하고 넘어갔다. 목격자분들이 그 상황을 음성 녹음, 촬영까지 해놓으셨는데, 그분들이 아니었으면 증거를 남기지도 못했을 것이다.”)

"Also, the perpetrator came in holding a plastic bag. But when he left the scene, the bag was gone. I suspect it might have been to hinder forensic examination. Five months later, I went directly to the convenience store and asked if I could see the CCTV or purchase records. But too much time had already passed, and the evidence had been discarded." (“또 가해자가 봉투를 하나 들고 왔었다. 그런데 현장을 떠날 때는 봉투가 없다. 감식을 방해하려는 용도가 아니었을까 싶다. 5개월이 지나 제가 직접 편의점에 가서 CCTV나 구매 내역을 볼 수 있냐고 물었다. 그런데 이미 너무 시간이 지나서 증거물이 없어져버린 상태였다.”)

Why do you think the police in charge of the case acted that way at the time? (사건을 담당했던 경찰은 그때 왜 그랬을까.)

"I think it was because time was tight, since they arrested the perpetrator just three days after he fled. Of course, that's just my speculation. They were so focused on catching the perpetrator during the investigation stage that afterward, they probably didn't have much time to question me." (“가해자를 도주 3일 만에 검거했기 때문에 시간이 좀 촉박했던 것 같다. 물론 제 추측이다. 수사 단계에서 가해자를 잡는 데 너무 신경을 쓰다 보니, 그 이후에 (저에게) 질문할 수 있는 시간이 많지 않았을 것 같다.”)

Why do you think this kind of gap occurred? (이런 공백이 왜 생겼다고 보나.)

"It's more of a structural problem than the malice of individual investigators. It's the result of a combination of factors: a practice of only doing just enough so you don't have to take responsibility, and the difference in legal review capabilities between the prosecution and the police. Of course, the prosecution isn't always perfect either. That's why the structure of the two agencies complementing each other is itself important." (“수사관 개인의 악의라기보다 구조적 문제다. 책임질 필요가 없는 선까지만 하면 되는 관행, 그리고 검찰과 경찰 간 법리 검토 역량 차이 등이 겹친 결과다. 물론 검찰이라고 해서 당연히 항상 완벽한 것은 아니다. 그렇기 때문에 두 기관이 서로 보완하는 구조 자체가 중요하다.”)

It was reported that the perpetrator made retaliatory remarks toward the victim from prison, and he was given an additional prison sentence. (가해자가 옥중에서 피해자를 향해 보복성 발언을 한 사실이 알려져 추가로 실형을 선고받기도 했다. )

"The perpetrator in my case was a repeat offender. So, to get a reduced sentence, he wrote 11 letters of repentance. Giving lenient sentencing standards and giving these people a chance and time to live law-abiding lives again ends up, in my view, making them commit other crimes. If the supplementary investigation authority is also abolished in this situation, it will become even easier for repeat offenders to exploit the system." (“제 사건 가해자는 전과자였다. 그래서 감형을 위해 11장의 반성문을 썼다. 너그러운 양형 기준을 주고, 이 사람들한테 다시 모범적으로 살아갈 기회와 시간을 주는 게 결국에는 그들이 또 다른 범죄를 저지르게 만드는 셈이 됐다고 생각한다. 이런 상황에서 보완수사권까지 없어지면, 전과자들이 제도를 악용하기가 더 쉬워질 것이다.”)

What other side effects do you anticipate? (예상되는 또 다른 부작용은.)

"Actually, if investigative authority rests only with one side, it can also be disadvantageous to the suspect. If the opportunity to cross-verify the credibility of statements at two stages disappears, the possibility of wrongful defendants emerging also grows. In the sense that a wrongfully accused defendant is also a 'victim of a flawed system,' their concerns wouldn't be any different from those of crime victims." (“사실 수사권이 한쪽에만 있으면 피의자에게도 불리할 수 있다. 두 단계에서 진술의 신빙성을 교차 검증할 기회가 사라지면, 결국 억울한 피고인이 생길 가능성도 함께 커진다. 억울한 피고인 역시 ‘잘못된 제도의 피해자’라는 점에서 피해자들의 문제의식과 다르지 않을 것이다.”)

I heard you run a victim community yourself. What kinds of stories are being shared there now? (피해자 커뮤니티를 직접 운영하고 있다고 들었다. 지금 어떤 이야기들이 오가고 있나.)

"I'm only able to say this now, but going through an incident like this leaves you completely disoriented. Both I and my family were in a state of panic. My sister also developed PTSD from watching the CCTV footage and couldn't really talk to me about it. I had to undergo all the investigations while I hadn't fully recovered, since not much time had passed after the incident." (“저도 지금에서야 이렇게 말할 수 있는 것이지, 사건을 겪어보면 정신이 하나도 없다. 저부터 가족까지 모두 패닉 상태였다. 언니도 CCTV를 보고 PTSD(외상후스트레스장애)가 와서 저에게 별다른 얘기를 못 해줬었다. 사건이 발생한 지 얼마 되지 않아 회복이 완전히 이뤄지지 않았던 상태에서 저는 모든 조사에 임해야 했다.”)

"Posts about the supplementary investigation authority don't really appear on the community bulletin board even now. Instead, I receive personal emails asking things like, 'I'm being treated this way at the investigation stage, is this right?' or 'I don't know what to do.' All I can do is listen, but I think they reach out because I've been through it myself." (“커뮤니티 게시판에는 지금도 보완수사권 이야기는 잘 올라오지 않는다. 대신 개인 메일로 ‘지금 수사 단계에서 이런 대우를 받고 있는데 이게 맞느냐’ ‘어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠다’는 문의가 온다. 제가 해줄 수 있는 것은 그저 들어주는 것뿐이지만, 겪어본 사람이기에 물어오는 것 같다.”)

item.title: 'Amid 'Moon Jae-in Season 2' Concerns, Tax Bomb... Ruling Camp Also Raises 'Reform' Calls Amid Public Backlash (‘문재인 시즌 2’ 우려 속 세금 폭탄… 민심 반발에 여권도 ‘수정론’)
item.description:
'Amid 'Moon Jae-in Season 2' Concerns, Tax Bomb... Ruling Camp Also Raises 'Reform' Calls Amid Public Backlash (‘문재인 시즌 2’ 우려 속 세금 폭탄… 민심 반발에 여권도 ‘수정론’)

Since the government announced its plan to strengthen comprehensive real estate taxes and capital gains taxes on non-resident single-home owners and owners of ultra-high-priced homes, voices of concern over worsening public sentiment have grown within the ruling camp. This is because homeowners in the Seoul and surrounding metropolitan areas, who now face sudden tax burdens from tax- and regulation-focused real estate policies, are strongly pushing back against the government's approach. (비거주 1주택자와 초고가 주택 보유자에 대한 정부의 종부세·양도세 강화 방안이 발표된 이후 여권에선 여론 악화를 걱정하는 목소리가 커지고 있습니다. 세금·규제 위주의 부동산 정책으로 인해 급격한 세 부담을 안게 된 서울·수도권 지역 주택 보유자들이 정부 정책에 강하게 반발하고 있기 때문입니다.)

There is considerable public criticism circulating, such as: "Many non-resident single-home owners or long-term holders of high-priced homes have nothing to do with real estate speculation, yet they're about to get hit with a tax bomb," and "The government is treating homeowners as speculators." The question being raised is why the government is blaming homeowners for its policy failures and imposing heavy tax burdens on them. (시중에선 “비거주 1주택자나 고가 주택 장기 보유자 중 상당수는 부동산 투기와 거리가 먼데 세금 폭탄을 맞게 생겼다” “정부가 주택 보유자들을 투기꾼으로 몰고 있다”는 비판 여론이 적잖습니다. 왜 정부의 정책 실패를 주택 보유자들 탓으로 돌리고 세금 폭탄을 안기느냐는 것입니다.)

The opposition party criticizes the government, saying, "While effective housing supply measures are being neglected, the government is only resorting to tax hikes and tighter regulations." There are also pointed remarks such as: "They won't bring down housing prices and will only worsen the lease and rent crisis," "This isn't a policy for the hungry and ordinary people, but one for those with sour grapes," and "It's a quixotic policy bordering on state violence." (야당에선 “실효성 있는 주택 공급 대책은 뒷전인 채 세금 인상과 규제 강화 카드만 쓰고 있다”고 비판합니다. “집값은 잡지도 못하고 전월세난만 가중시킬 것” “배고픈 사람과 서민을 위한 정책이 아니라 배 아픈 사람들을 위한 정책만 한다” “국가 폭력에 가까운 돈키호테 정책”이라는 지적도 나옵니다.)

Within the ruling camp, there are also significant signs of anxiety and concern. Criticisms include: "Housing prices can't be controlled with taxes and regulations alone," "This will only needlessly fuel the lease and rent crisis, leading to a disastrous defeat in the general election," and "The ruling party needs to revise the excessive tax hike plan." Democratic Party lawmakers from Seoul held a real estate forum and suggested, "We need to properly monitor the impact on the lease and rent market and non-resident single-home owners." (여권에서도 불안과 우려의 목소리가 큽니다. “세금·규제책만으론 집값을 못 잡는다” “공연히 전월세난만 야기해 총선에서 폭망할 수 있다” “무리한 세금 인상안은 여당이 수정할 필요가 있다”는 지적이 나옵니다. 민주당 서울 지역 의원들은 부동산 간담회를 열고 “전월세 시장과 비거주 1주택자에 대한 영향을 제대로 모니터링하자”는 의견을 냈습니다.)

Meanwhile, the rhetoric from the presidential office and the government regarding real estate has come under scrutiny. On the 6th, regarding the controversy over the government's tax reform proposal, the presidential office stated, "We have no intention of controlling housing prices through taxes." However, the measures actually unveiled by the government have been assessed as being close to a real estate tax increase plan aimed at pressuring non-resident single-home owners and owners of ultra-high-priced homes. In other words, while claiming verbally that these are not taxes intended to control housing prices, the government is in practice implementing punitive tax policies. (이런 가운데 청와대와 정부의 부동산 화법이 도마에 오르고 있습니다. 청와대는 지난 6일 정부의 세제 개편안 논란과 관련해 “세금으로 집값을 잡을 생각이 없다”고 했습니다. 하지만 실제로 정부가 내놓은 방안은 비거주 1주택자와 초고가 주택 보유자를 압박하기 위한 부동산 증세안에 가까웠다는 평가를 받고 있습니다. 말로는 집값 잡기용 세금이 아니라면서 실제로는 징벌적 세금 정책을 펴고 있다는 것입니다.)

The presidential office and the government also promised to quickly present housing supply measures. On the 7th, President Lee Jae-myung chaired a closed-door policy review meeting. At that meeting, President Lee said, "We must break away from conventional thinking and boldly implement housing supply," and instructed, "Review full-scale measures to expand supply." However, no specific plans or timelines were disclosed. (청와대와 정부는 주택 공급 대책도 신속하게 내놓겠다고 했습니다. 7일에는 이재명 대통령 주재로 비공개 정책 점검 회의도 열었습니다. 이 자리에서 이재명 대통령은 “기존 사고를 벗어나 주택 공급을 과감하게 실천해야 한다”며 “전폭적인 공급 확대 방안을 검토하라”고 했습니다. 하지만 구체적 방안이나 시기는 밝히지 않았습니다.)

It is said that the supply measures currently being prepared by the government are not significantly different from those already reviewed and pursued during the Moon Jae-in administration. Most are plans that could not be implemented due to resident opposition and objections from local governments. The opposition party criticizes, "They overuse tax and regulation measures, but when it comes to actual supply measures, they only beat around the bush and offer recycled, warmed-over plans." (현재 정부가 준비 중인 공급 방안은 문재인 정부에서 이미 검토·추진했던 것과 크게 다르지 않다고 합니다. 주민 반발과 지자체 반대로 추진하지 못했던 것들이 대부분입니다. 야당은 “세금·규제책은 남발하더니 정작 공급 대책은 변죽만 울리고 재탕 삼탕식 방안만 내놓는다”고 비판합니다.)

President Lee Jae-myung's remarks have also come under fire. The President said, "Even with good intentions, if a policy harms the people, it's better not to do it at all." The opposition side criticizes, "The things causing the greatest harm to the people right now are the government's real estate measures and the reckless push to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers," and adds, "The right thing to do is to halt both first." Some have also pointed out, "Words and policies are going in different directions," and called it "out-of-body rhetoric." (이재명 대통령의 발언도 도마에 올랐습니다. 이 대통령은 “의도가 좋아도 국민에게 피해를 주면 안 하니만 못하다”고 말했습니다. 야권에선 “지금 국민에게 가장 큰 피해를 주고 있는 건 정부의 부동산 대책과 검찰 보완 수사권 폐지 폭주”라며 “두 가지부터 중단하는 게 옳다”고 비판합니다. 일각에선 “말 따로 정책 따로” “유체 이탈 화법”이라는 지적도 나옵니다.)

On the 6th, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Sung Ki-hong said, "There is no intention to control housing prices through taxes." He also stated, "The tax reform is not about controlling housing prices but about fair taxation." The Deputy Minister of Economy and Finance also said, "It is not aimed at increasing tax revenue." President Lee had also expressed a similar stance. (청와대 성기홍 홍보수석은 6일 “세금으로 집값 잡을 생각이 없다”고 했습니다. 성 수석은 “세제 개편은 집값 잡기용이 아니라 공정 과세를 위한 것”이라고도 했습니다. 재경부 차관도 “세수 증대 목적이 아니다”라고 했습니다. 이 대통령도 비슷한 입장을 밝혔었습니다.)

However, looking at the real estate tax reform plan, many assess it as being close to punitive tax increases. While single-home owners who actually reside in their homes would see a slight reduction in their comprehensive real estate tax, non-resident single-home owners and owners of high-priced homes would see their tax burdens increase significantly. Among them are many long-term owners with no connection to speculation, as well as non-resident single-home owners who have no choice in their situation. The plan appears intended to impose such high taxes on them that they cannot hold onto their properties without selling. (그런데 부동산 세제 개편안을 보면 징벌적 증세에 가깝다는 평가가 많습니다. 실거주 1주택자는 종부세가 소폭 줄지만, 비거주 1주택자와 고가 주택자는 세부담이 크게 늘어납니다. 이 중에는 투기와 거리가 먼 장기 보유자나 어쩔 수 없는 1주택 비거주자도 많은데요. 이들에게까지 높은 세금을 매겨서 집을 팔지 않고는 못 버티게 하겠다는 의도로 비칩니다.)

Yet, the government insists these are not taxes meant to control housing prices. If they aren't, then there's no clear explanation for why they are being pushed so aggressively at this time. This is why homeowners are pointing out, "Aren't they just fooling themselves?" and "Their words and actions don't match." (그런데도 정부는 집값 잡기용 세금이 아니라고 얘기합니다. 집값 잡기용이 아니라면 지금 이 시점에 무리하게 추진할 이유가 무엇인지 설명이 잘 되지 않습니다. 주택 보유자들 사이에 “눈 가리고 아웅 아니냐” “말 따로 행동 따로”라는 지적이 나오는 이유입니다.)

Although the government, with President Lee himself repeatedly emphasizing it, has promised to quickly release supply measures, the official announcement keeps being delayed. For real estate measures to be effective, supply measures and demand-suppression policies must be introduced simultaneously. But, effective supply measures are nowhere to be seen, and only tax- and regulation-focused policies are pouring out. (정부는 공급 대책을 신속히 내놓겠다고 이 대통령까지 나서서 거듭 강조했지만, 공식 발표는 계속 늦어지고 있습니다. 부동산 대책이 효과를 내려면 공급 대책과 수요 억제책이 동시에 나와야 합니다. 그런데 실효성 있는 공급 대책은 보이지 않고 세금·규제책만 쏟아지는 모양새입니다.)

The government is reviewing candidates such as Yongsan Children's Park, the Suseo vehicle depot, Gwacheon Racecourse, the Naegok-dong greenbelt, and various school and public sites. Most of these are places already reviewed and pursued during the Moon Jae-in administration, where little progress was made due to resident opposition, local government objections, and legal issues. (정부는 용산 어린이 공원, 수서 차량기지, 과천 경마장, 내곡동 그린벨트, 각종 학교·공공 부지 등을 후보로 검토하고 있는데요. 문재인 정부 때 이미 검토·추진했던 곳이 대부분입니다. 주민 반발과 지자체 반대, 법적인 문제 등으로 진전이 거의 되지 않은 곳들입니다.)

Even the two supply measures announced so far by this administration have seen construction starts at only around 20 percent of the targets. As a result, there is considerable concern in the market, such as: "They're just beating around the bush," "Does the Lee Jae-myung administration really have some magic trick?" and "Aren't we going to get recycled, numbers-filling plans again?" (이 정부가 발표한 두 차례의 공급 대책도 착공 실적이 목표치의 20% 안팎에 그칩니다. 그래서 시장에선 “변죽만 올린다” “이재명 정부라고 용빼는 재주가 있겠느냐” “숫자만 채우는 재탕 삼탕식 대책이 나오는 것 아니냐”는 우려가 적잖습니다.)

Regarding the government's real estate measures, there are criticisms that it's "supply in name, taxes and regulations in reality." Why is the government focusing more on tax policies than on supply? Because taxes and regulations are easy, while supply is hard. Taxes can be implemented quickly and easily. Supply, on the other hand, requires long-term planning of 5 to 10 years, preparation, and steady execution. This is why progressive governments have often pulled out the tax-and-regulation card like a trusted weapon whenever housing prices started to surge. (정부의 부동산 대책을 놓고는 ‘말로는 공급, 실제는 세금·규제’라는 지적이 나옵니다. 정부는 왜 공급보다 세금 정책에 치중하는 걸까요. 세금·규제는 쉽고 공급은 힘들기 때문입니다. 세금은 빠르고 쉽게 시행할 수 있습니다. 반면 공급은 5~10년 장기간 계획하고 준비한 뒤 꾸준하게 실행해야 합니다. 그래서 진보 정부들은 집값만 들썩이면 전가의 보도처럼 세금·규제 카드를 꺼내 들곤 했습니다.)

Another reason is the excessive obsession of the government and ruling camp with public development. In fact, the main actors in housing supply are the private sector and the market. The government's important role is to facilitate and oversee this. But progressive governments insist, "We can't trust the private sector; we must pursue public development." President Lee also said in effect, "Rebuilding and redevelopment projects have little effect." However, there aren't many large sites remaining in Seoul and its surrounding areas for large-scale public development. (또 다른 이유는 정부와 여권의 과도한 공공 개발 집착증입니다. 사실 주택 공급의 주역은 민간과 시장입니다. 정부는 이를 촉진하거나 감독하는 역할이 중요합니다. 그런데 진보 정부는 ‘민간은 못 믿는다, 공공 개발을 해야 한다’고 주장합니다. 이 대통령도 “재건축·재개발은 별 효과가 없다”는 취지로 말했습니다. 그러나 서울과 그 인근 지역에는 대규모 공공 개발을 할 대형 부지가 별로 남아 있지 않습니다.)

The ruling camp's phobia of rebuilding and redevelopment projects is also a factor. The thinking goes: "If apartments are rebuilt or redeveloped, those areas become more conservative, which means the ruling party loses votes." As a result, there is a tendency to increase public rental housing while delaying the supply of quality housing. (여권의 재건축·재개발 공포증도 한 원인입니다. “아파트를 재건축·재개발하면 그 지역이 보수화된다, 그러면 여당 표가 떨어진다”는 것입니다. 그래서 임대주택은 늘리고 양질의 주택 공급은 미뤄지는 측면이 있습니다.)

Regarding this set of real estate measures, there is also concern and dissatisfaction within the ruling party itself. In particular, lawmakers from Seoul express strong opposition and a sense of crisis. There are considerable voices saying, "Housing prices can't be controlled with taxes alone," "If public sentiment worsens, we could lose the general election," and "Owning one home is a basic right, so even non-resident single-home owners should be protected." (이번 부동산 대책에 대해선 여당 내부에서도 우려와 불만이 나오고 있습니다. 특히 서울 지역 의원들의 반발과 위기감이 큽니다. “세금만으론 집값 잡기 힘들다” “여론이 악화되면 총선에서 망할 수 있다” “1주택은 기본권인데 비거주 1주택자도 보호해 줘야 한다”는 목소리가 적잖습니다.)

Some are even going so far as to argue for revising the government's plan. They say, "The ruling party should craft a reform plan that the public can accept and persuade the government to adopt it." The opposition party criticizes, saying, "The lease and rent crisis is making homeless ordinary people cry too," and "It's state violence and a quixotic policy fighting windmills in the wrong place." (일각에선 정부안을 수정하자는 주장까지 펴는데요. “국민들이 수용할 수 있는 개편안을 여당이 다시 만들어서 정부를 설득하자”는 겁니다. 야당은 “전월세난으로 집없는 서민들까지 울린다” “국가 폭력이고 엉뚱한 데 가서 싸우는 돈키호테 정책”이라고 비판합니다.)
